clue.text: Exclusive surroundings for start of vigorous work out

indicators.note: surroundings for says the first word wraps round the letter that follows

parts.note: exclusive, as in sole rights, means sole

indicators.note: the start of a word is its opening letter

explanation.surface: Someone sets about an exclusive, vigorous workout.
explanation.walkthrough: 'surroundings for' puts V, the start of 'vigorous', inside SOLE.
explanation.definitionFit: To solve a problem is to puzzle it through to its result.

clue.text: Computer control under glass plate

indicators.note: under in a down clue puts the second piece below the first

parts.note: a microscope slide is a glass plate
to rule is to control

explanation.surface: Computer controls sit beneath a pane of glass.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Computer' means one who computes: a slide rule was the old calculating tool.
explanation.definitionFit: A slide rule is a calculating device, used for working out sums before electronic calculators.

clue.text: A pound each way is the minimum

parts.note: L, from libra, stands for a pound
St, street, is a way

explanation.surface: A pound bet each way is the smallest stake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'each way' is a betting phrase but splits into EA and ST.
explanation.definitionFit: The least is the smallest amount possible.

clue.text: City no environment for living areas

parts.note: EC is the postcode of the City of London, the financial district
O, nought, means no
a sphere is a field or area of activity

explanation.surface: A city lacks any environment for living spaces.
explanation.definitionFit: An ecosphere is the zone of the planet where organisms can exist.

clue.text: Large region can become easy to control

parts.note: a tract is a large stretch of land
to be able is to be capable, so can means able

explanation.surface: A large territory proves easy to govern.
explanation.definitionFit: Tractable describes someone docile and manageable, readily handled.

clue.text: Kitchen equipment at store for reconditioning

indicators.note: reconditioning means putting back together differently, so these letters are reworked

explanation.surface: Kitchen appliances are held at a shop for refurbishment.
explanation.definitionFit: A toaster is an electrical appliance that browns bread.

clue.text: In the style of scholars in the USA

parts.note: a la, French, means in the style of
a BA is a Bachelor of Arts
an MA is a Master of Arts

explanation.surface: American academics have their own particular manner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in the USA' points to a place there: the state is the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Alabama is a state of the American South.

clue.text: Somersaulting German with performing Athenian

indicators.note: a somersault flips over, so the German word is turned back to front

parts.note: mit is German for with
on stage means performing

explanation.surface: A tumbling German appears with an acrobat from Athens.
explanation.walkthrough: 'German with' means the German for 'with'. Shakespeare's Timon of Athens is the Athenian.
explanation.definitionFit: Timon of Athens is the misanthropic Athenian of Shakespeare's play.

clue.text: A feature topped by unadorned canopy

indicators.note: topped by in a down clue puts the second piece above the first

parts.note: bald means plain, unadorned
the chin is a facial feature

explanation.surface: A characteristic is crowned by a plain covering.
explanation.definitionFit: A baldachin is a ceremonial canopy over an altar or throne.

clue.text: Correct electrical lead to carry out repair

indicators.note: the lead of a word is its first letter

parts.note: to mend is to repair

explanation.surface: Proper electrical wiring is needed to fix something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lead' looks like a cable but means the first letter of 'electrical'.
explanation.definitionFit: To emend is to correct a text.

clue.text: Repellent Arab deserter takes a lover

indicators.note: read as repel-lent, driven back, so the word for an Arab is turned round

parts.note: an Omani is an Arab from Oman
a rat deserts a sinking ship, so a rat is a deserter

explanation.surface: A disgusting Arab runaway acquires a sweetheart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Repellent' looks like 'disgusting', but it signals OMANI read backwards, giving INAMO; 'takes' just joins the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: An inamorata is a woman who is loved, a female sweetheart.

clue.text: I object to a general brawl

parts.note: I as a grammatical object is me
Robert E. Lee was the Confederate general in the American Civil War

explanation.surface: Someone protests to an officer about a fight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'object' is grammatical: the object form of I is ME, not a protest.
explanation.definitionFit: A melee is a confused hand-to-hand fight among many people.

clue.text: Lawfully prevent some chest operations

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A court bans some kinds of thoracic surgery.
explanation.definitionFit: Estop is a legal term meaning to bar a party from asserting something.

clue.text: Coach party for old soldiers' company

parts.note: to coach is to train
a party of people is a band

explanation.surface: A coach outing is laid on for a group of veterans.
explanation.definitionFit: Trainbands were citizen militia companies in England from the 16th to 18th centuries.

clue.text: Nuclear fission not easily detected

indicators.note: fission is splitting apart, so the letters of the word nuclear are broken up and reformed

explanation.surface: Nuclear fission is something hard to spot.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unclear is obscure, hard to make out.

clue.text: Adjustable new chair a service perhaps for diner

indicators.note: adjustable means it can be altered, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A new adjustable seat serves a diner.
explanation.definitionFit: A dinner service, a set of plates and dishes, is porcelain crockery.

clue.text: Showboat a floating vessel

parts.note: to air views is to show them
a ship is a boat

explanation.surface: A showboat is a vessel afloat on a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Showboat' looks like one word, a river paddle steamer, but it splits into 'Show' and 'boat'.
explanation.definitionFit: A dirigible floats in the air, a craft buoyed up by gas.

clue.text: One taking back overturned rubbish carrier

indicators.note: overturned says the whole phrase is flipped and read backwards

parts.note: rot means rubbish, nonsense
a carter carries goods by cart

explanation.surface: A refuse truck is tipped over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'overturned' reverses ROT + CARTER as one run, giving RETRAC + TOR.
explanation.definitionFit: A retractor is someone who withdraws a statement.

clue.text: Money transmitted for inclusion in trust with little delay

parts.note: p, a penny, stands for money

indicators.note: for inclusion in says one piece goes inside the next

parts.note: to rely on is to trust
sent means transmitted

explanation.surface: Funds are wired into a trust fund soon.
explanation.definitionFit: Presently means soon, before long.

clue.text: Not a good looker, but thought charming by some

explanation.surface: Someone plain is nevertheless found charming by a few.
explanation.walkthrough: 'charming' means casting a charm or spell, not attractive.
explanation.definitionFit: A malevolent glance is a bad look, and many believe such a stare can bewitch or curse.

clue.text: Put up note after alteration of leave

indicators.note: after places the note following the rearranged letters
an alteration changes something, so the letters of leave are reworked

parts.note: te is a note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: Someone posts a notice after changing their leave.
explanation.walkthrough: 'alteration of' rearranges LEAVE to ELEVA; 'after' puts TE behind it.
explanation.definitionFit: To elevate is to raise or lift.

clue.text: Camp in river setting for relaxation of tension

indicators.note: in says the camp is placed within the river's name

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Scotland and another in Wales and England
a tent is a camp shelter

explanation.surface: A camp beside a river is a restful setting.
explanation.definitionFit: Detente is the easing of hostility between nations.

clue.text: Dispense with boss of underworld club possibly

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god of the underworld
a club is a playing card, one of the suits

explanation.surface: Someone gets rid of a gangster's nightclub.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boss of underworld' looks like a crime lord, but is Dis, ruler of the dead.
explanation.definitionFit: To discard is to throw away.

clue.text: Unblemished, like Stephen

explanation.surface: Someone spotless is compared to a man called Stephen.
explanation.walkthrough: Stainless Stephen was a British music-hall and radio comedian of the 1920s-30s, famous for speaking his punctuation aloud.
explanation.definitionFit: Without stain means spotless, and the comedian's stage name was Stainless Stephen.

clue.text: Gives away purchases

explanation.surface: Someone gives away what they buy.
explanation.definitionFit: To shop someone is to inform on them, and shops are places for buying goods.

clue.text: "… she hangs upon the cheek of —" (R. and J.)

definitions.text: she hangs upon the cheek of —" (R. and J

parts.words: she hangs upon the cheek of
parts.note: Romeo describes Juliet as a jewel hanging upon the dark's cheek: fill the missing word of the quotation

explanation.walkthrough: From Romeo and Juliet: "It seems she hangs upon the cheek of night / As a rich jewel in an Ethiop's ear".
explanation.definitionFit: The quotation compares Juliet to a jewel against the dark hours after sunset.

clue.text: Drink is taken in the gangway

indicators.note: taken in says one piece is swallowed inside another

parts.note: ale is a drink, beer

explanation.surface: Someone has a drink standing in the passage.
explanation.definitionFit: An aisle is a walkway between rows of seats.

clue.text: After the first of September we will expand

indicators.note: after places the contraction behind that opening letter
the first of a word is its opening letter

parts.note: we'll, written without its apostrophe, is the contraction of we will

explanation.surface: From early September we will grow.
explanation.definitionFit: To swell is to grow larger.

clue.text: Creature wanting the last of the fruit

indicators.note: wanting means lacking, so a letter is removed

parts.note: an orange is a fruit

indicators.note: the last of a word is its final letter

explanation.surface: An animal craves the remaining fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wanting' looks like desire, but means lacking: ORANGE loses E, the last letter of 'the'.
explanation.definitionFit: Orang is short for orang-utan, the great ape.

clue.text: Manet and Monet, for instance, in appropriate accommodation

indicators.note: in says the painters sit inside the word for fitting

parts.note: apt means appropriate
the two French painters are examples of art men, artists

explanation.surface: Two Impressionists live in suitable lodgings.
explanation.definitionFit: A flat or suite of rooms is somewhere to live.

clue.text: These may be belted, with bow and knot

parts.note: rain belting down falls in sheets
a bend is a bow or curve

explanation.surface: Things that may be strapped come with a bow and knot.
explanation.walkthrough: A sheet bend is a sailor's knot for joining two ropes.
explanation.definitionFit: The sheet bend is a common knot tied between two lines.

clue.text: Gathering, everybody in lines

indicators.note: in says everybody is placed inside the lines

parts.note: RY, railway, means lines
all means everybody

explanation.surface: A gathering where everyone stands in rows.
explanation.definitionFit: A rally is a mass meeting of supporters.
